text: Hello my friend.
zh: 你好，我的朋友。

text: What is it, that #:Rair:# can do for you?
zh: 有什么是#:莱尔:#能为你效劳的？

text: Where am I?
zh: 我这是在哪儿？

text: I need information...
zh: 我需要打听些消息……

text: Who are the drunk men in the corner?
zh: 角落里那几个醉汉是什么人？

text: I could take care of Thorald.
zh: 我可以帮你解决索拉尔德。

text: Thorald will pay the bills.
zh: 索拉尔德会付账的。

text: Thorald won't show up again.
zh: 索拉尔德不会再来了。

text: Show me your wares.
zh: 让我看看你的货。

text: What do you know about the Arcanum Sanguis?
zh: 你对血之秘典了解多少？

text: Let's talk about these orders.
zh: 我们谈谈这些命令吧。

text: I know where the Arcanum Sanguis is hidden.
zh: 我知道血之秘典藏在哪里。

text: The raiders stole it for Lord Margyott.
zh: 是掠夺者替马尔乔特领主偷走了它。

text: Are you interested in a book called the Arcanum Sanguis?
zh: 你对一本叫血之秘典的书感兴趣吗？

text: Do you have a room available?
zh: 你这儿有空房吗？

text: See you.
zh: 回见。

text:
At the Crossroad Inn.
The best tavern around.
zh:
在十字路旅店。
这一带最好的酒馆。

text: Sure... What do you want to know?
zh: 当然……你想知道什么？

text: What do you know about the capital?
zh: 你对王都了解多少？

text: How can I get a permit for the capital?
zh: 我怎样才能拿到进入王都的通行证？

text: Tell me about the nearby areas.
zh: 跟我说说附近的地方吧。

text: How do I get to the Marin cliffs?
zh: 我要怎么去马林悬崖？

text: Where do you get your wine from?
zh: 你的酒是从哪儿进的？

text: Nothing at the moment.
zh: 暂时没什么事。

text: I only know that the guards won't let just anyone inside the capital.
zh: 我只知道卫兵不会随便放人进王都。

text: Usually, you'll need a passport or a permit.
zh: 通常来说，你需要护照或者通行证。

text: There are other ways, but none of them would fit you, my friend.
zh: 也有别的路子，不过没一条适合你，我的朋友。

text: Let me think...
zh: 让我想想……

text: I am very forgetful lately...
zh: 我最近特别健忘……

text: Let me help (give 100 gold).
zh: 让我帮帮你（给100金币）。

text: Forget it.
zh: 算了。

text: Ahh yes, I remember now.
zh: 啊，对了，我想起来了。

text: I heard that you can buy a permit at the caravan to the west. Speaking to their leader should suffice.
zh: 我听说在西边的商队那儿能买到通行证。去找他们的头儿谈谈就行。

text: Sure.
zh: 当然。

text: East of here, there's the passage to the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Icefall Village#text.default#.
zh: 往东走，是通往#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#冰瀑村#text.default#的通道。

text: However, the passage froze over a while ago, so there's no new caravans here.
zh: 不过那条通道前阵子被冻住了，所以这里没有新商队来。

text: It is also a stopover for the caravan of the Icefall Village.
zh: 这里也是冰瀑村商队的中转站。

text: To the north, there are the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Marin Cliffs#text.default#.
zh: 往北，是#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#马林悬崖#text.default#。

text: This may be a problem for the village, as they rely on the traveling merchants of the caravans.
zh: 这对村子来说可能是个麻烦，他们全指望商队的行商过活。

text: Without proper equipment, you shouldn't even think about going up there.
zh: 没有合适的装备，你想都别想上去。

text: Last but not least, the Royal Army is guarding the passage to the south.
zh: 最后，皇家军队把守着南边的通道。

text: Southeast, there's the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Rhoga Swamp#text.default#, but I don't know anything about it.
zh: 东南方向是#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#罗加沼泽#text.default#，不过那里的事我一无所知。

text: Who knows what lies beyond that one.
zh: 谁知道那后面藏着什么。

text: Come back later.
zh: 回头再来吧。

text: Come again, my friend.
zh: 下次再来，我的朋友。

text: You mean the people in the red armor?
zh: 你是说那些穿红甲的人？

text: They are royal knights.
zh: 他们是皇家骑士。

text: Thorald, the leader of the small group here, was talking about quality check.
zh: 索拉尔德，就是这一小队人的头儿，之前说是来做什么质量检查。

text: Since then, these - ahem - noble knights have been getting drunk at my expense.
zh: 从那以后，这些——咳——高贵的骑士就一直在这儿白吃白喝地灌酒。

text:
You could?
He is a royal knight, you know?
zh:
你可以？
他可是皇家骑士，你知道吧？

text: I wish he would leave the Inn for good.
zh: 我真希望他能永远离开这家旅店。

text: But I don't want to have problems with the royal guard.
zh: 但我可不想跟皇家卫队惹上麻烦。

text: He is still here, but at least he will pay for his beer.
zh: 他虽然还赖在这儿，但至少肯付酒钱了。

text: Maybe, he will be an alright customer at the end, haha.
zh: 说不定到头来他还算个不错的客人呢，哈哈。

text:
I see.
Now he won't cause any more troubles.
zh:
我明白了。
这下他不会再惹麻烦了。

text: However, thank you so much for dealing with Thorald.
zh: 不管怎样，非常感谢你帮我处理了索拉尔德。

text: I sure hope, the royal guard won't be a problem, though.
zh: 不过我真心希望皇家卫队那边别出什么岔子。

text: As far as I know, the guards do exactly what they have to do.
zh: 据我所知，卫兵们只是照章办事。

text: Unless you get a permit, signed by the king, or get strong enough, you won't be able to access the passage.
zh: 除非你拿到国王签发的通行证，或者变得足够强，否则你过不了那条通道。

text:
One is as troublesome as the other, right?
How about another option?
zh:
两条路一样麻烦，对吧？
要不要考虑另一种办法？

text: Come back later, and I may sell you a... permit...
zh: 回头再来，也许我能卖你一张……通行证……

text: I don't know what you're talking about, my friend.
zh: 我不知道你在说什么，我的朋友。

text: I took care of the drunkard for you.
zh: 我帮你解决了那个醉鬼。

text: I took care of the drunkard for you.
zh: 我帮你解决了那个醉鬼。

text: How can I help jog your memory?
zh: 我要怎么帮你恢复记忆？

text: That letter says something different.
zh: 那封信上说的可不是这样。

text: We'll talk about it later.
zh: 我们回头再谈。

text: But he is still here in the Inn.
zh: 但他人还在旅店里。

text:
And you kicked him out of the tavern.
Well, I shall tell you about the book.
zh:
而且你还把他赶出了酒馆。
好吧，我这就跟你说说那本书的事。

text: I don't think that this is enough to make me remember...
zh: 我觉得光这样还不足以让我想起来……

text: The truth is I was involved in the theft of that book.
zh: 实话说，那本书失窃的事，我也有份参与。

text:
I heard that the Arcanum Sanguis is a dangerous book.
Therefore, information about it is not without risk.
zh:
我听说血之秘典是本危险的书。
所以，跟它有关的消息也不是没有风险的。

text: I don't know what about.
zh: 我不知道要谈什么。

text:
You took care of the drunkard.
But he is still here in the Inn.
zh:
你是解决了那个醉鬼。
但他人还在旅店里。

text: I think 250 gold should be enough to make me remember that day.
zh: 我想，250金币应该足够让我想起那天的事了。

text: Here are 250 gold.
zh: 这是250金币。

text: That is too much.
zh: 太贵了。

text: Unfortunately, I don't know what else we should talk about.
zh: 很遗憾，我不知道我们还有什么好谈的。

text:
Thank you!
I think I remember what happened.
zh:
谢谢！
我想我记起当时发生了什么。

text: You took care of the drunkard.
zh: 你解决了那个醉鬼。

text:
And you kicked him out of the tavern.
Well, I shall tell you about the book.
zh:
而且你还把他赶出了酒馆。
好吧，我这就跟你说说那本书的事。

text: I'm sure I'll need 500 gold to remember this information.
zh: 我确定得有500金币才能让我记起这件事。

text: Here are 500 gold.
zh: 这是500金币。

text: That is too much.
zh: 太贵了。

text: We had a pickup planned for the wine. While we were negotiating about the price, one of the other thieves stole the book.
zh: 我们本来安排好了去取酒。就在我们讨价还价的时候，另一个贼把书偷了出来。

text: However, the book was stolen from us while we were making our way back through the Marin Passage.
zh: 可是，在我们经马林通道返回的路上，书又被人从我们手里抢走了。

text: Raiders attacked us and our carriage.
zh: 掠夺者袭击了我们和我们的马车。

text: Not only did they steal all our wine, but also that damn book.
zh: 他们不但抢走了我们所有的酒，还抢走了那本该死的书。

text: My client was outraged. But we settled the problem by simply forgetting about the theft.
zh: 我的客户大发雷霆。不过最后我们就当失窃这事没发生过，把问题了结了。

text: That’s all I know, I promise.
zh: 我知道的就这么多，我发誓。

text: Why did you know where the book was?
zh: 你怎么会知道书在哪里？

text: Who was involved in the operation?
zh: 都有谁参与了这次行动？

text: Who was your client?
zh: 你的客户是谁？

text: Where is the carriage now?
zh: 那辆马车现在在哪里？

text: That's all. Thank you!
zh: 就这些了。谢谢你！

text: We got the exact information from my client.
zh: 确切的消息是我的客户提供的。

text: Our only job was to execute the plan within a certain time and deliver the book.
zh: 我们的任务只是在限定时间内执行计划，把书送到。

text: We were five in total.
zh: 我们一共五个人。

text: There was the one guy with the carriage and the horses.
zh: 有一个人负责马车和马匹。

text: He was not involved in the plan and was only needed for the wine.
zh: 他没有参与计划，只是运酒需要他。

text:
A pal of mine helped to steal the book.
He really makes everything disappear if he wants.
zh:
我的一个伙计帮忙偷的书。
只要他想，什么东西都能给你变没了。

text: Then, there were two other guys, which I did not know.
zh: 另外还有两个我不认识的家伙。

text: They were sent by my client to observe the whole operation and report back to him.
zh: 他们是我的客户派来的，负责监视整个行动并向他汇报。

text: That is something I can't tell.
zh: 这我可不能说。

text: No money on earth will make me give away my client's name.
zh: 给多少钱我都不会说出我客户的名字。

text: I am sure the carriage is still in the Marin Passage.
zh: 我敢肯定那辆马车还在马林通道里。

text: I haven't been in there since then, so I don't know for sure.
zh: 不过打那以后我就没再进去过，所以也说不准。

text: Take a look at my wares before you leave.
zh: 走之前看看我的货吧。

text: Your dry throat could certainly use a drink or two, right?
zh: 你干渴的喉咙肯定需要一两杯酒润润，对吧？

text:
A letter?
Let me see.
zh:
一封信？
让我看看。

text:
What? How?
The whole operation was a trap!
zh:
什么？怎么会？
整个行动就是个圈套！

text: Here's your letter.
zh: 信还给你。

text: Let me see.
zh: 让我看看。

text: I can't believe, that the whole operation to steal the book has been a trap.
zh: 真不敢相信，偷书的整个行动竟然是个圈套。

text:
But who gave the order?
It must be someone who knew about the plan!
zh:
可命令是谁下的？
一定是知道这个计划的人！

text: Come back to me when you find out more about the attack.
zh: 等你查到更多关于那次袭击的消息，再来找我。

text:
Well...
Where is it?
zh:
哦……
书在哪儿？

text: The book is locked inside a chest behind the waterfall.
zh: 书锁在瀑布后面的一个箱子里。

text: Lord Margyott?
zh: 马尔乔特领主？

text:
Haha, that was unexpected.
He was the one who ordered me to steal the book.
zh:
哈哈，这可真没想到。
当初就是他命令我去偷那本书的。

text:
To me, it sounds like he planned it and was playing a trick on me.
I won't let this go!
zh:
在我看来，这一切都是他策划的，他是在耍我。
这事我不会善罢甘休！

text:
Bring me the book if you find it.
I'd be happy to charge him double for that shit, haha!
zh:
要是你找到那本书，就拿来给我。
那破玩意儿我很乐意找他收双倍的钱，哈哈！

text: Let me guess. You can't open the chest by yourself?
zh: 我猜猜。你自己打不开那个箱子吧？

text: I can open the chest.
zh: 我能打开箱子。

text: That is right.
zh: 没错。

text:
What are you waiting for, then?
Go get the damn book!
zh:
那你还等什么？
快去把那本该死的书拿来！

text: I figured as much.
zh: 我早猜到了。

text: If you have enough money, you can ask a friend of mine to crack the chest.
zh: 只要你钱够多，可以去找我的一个朋友撬开那个箱子。

text: #:Jesse:# has opened every chest so far.
zh: 到目前为止，还没有#:杰西:#打不开的箱子。

text: In return, you'll get a fair share of the profits.
zh: 作为回报，你能分到一份可观的好处。

text: You'll find him atop the northern mountain pass in the bandit camp.
zh: 你可以在北方山口顶上的强盗营地里找到他。

text:
You son of a... 
Let me see!
zh:
你这个混……
让我看看！

text:
That is the book!
Haha, I knew you'd find and bring me the book.
zh:
就是这本书！
哈哈，我就知道你能把书找回来带给我。

text: Let's talk business.
zh: 我们来谈谈生意吧。

text: I'd give you 5000 gold for the book, if you're willing to sell that thing.
zh: 只要你愿意卖，这本书我出5000金币。

text: 5000 gold? We have a deal!
zh: 5000金币？成交！

text: I need to think about that.
zh: 我得考虑考虑。

text: Don't take too much time.
zh: 别考虑太久。

text:
Great!
Now, give me that stupid book.
zh:
太好了！
现在把那本破书给我吧。

text: And here's your payment.
zh: 这是给你的报酬。

text: Pleasure doin' business with you, my friend.
zh: 跟你做生意很愉快，我的朋友。

text: Sure thing. A paying customer is always welcome.
zh: 当然可以。付钱的客人永远欢迎。

text: You can rest in a room for the special price of 10 gold coins.
zh: 只要10金币的特价，你就能开间房好好休息。

text: You can rest in a room for the special price of 50 gold coins.
zh: 只要50金币的特价，你就能开间房好好休息。

text: You can rest in a room for the price of 100 gold coins.
zh: 只要100金币，你就能开间房好好休息。

text: Here. Take the 10 gold coins.
zh: 给。这是10金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Is there anything else you need?
zh: 你还需要点别的什么吗？

text: Here. Take the 50 gold coins.
zh: 给。这是50金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Here. Take the 100 gold coins.
zh: 给。这是100金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Have a good rest, my friend.
zh: 好好休息，我的朋友。

text:
The wine I offer comes exclusively from the academy.
There isn't much choice, though.
zh:
我卖的酒全部来自魔法学院。
不过选择不算多。

text: Did you sell any other wine?
zh: 你卖过别的酒吗？

text:
I did.
But that was a while ago, back when there was more trade around here.
zh:
卖过。
不过那是很久以前的事了，那时这一带的生意还多些。

text: Other wines weren't as popular as the Academy's wine, so I no longer sell any other bottles.
zh: 别的酒不如学院的酒受欢迎，所以后来我就不再卖其他的了。

text: Do you get your bottles directly from the academy?
zh: 你的酒是直接从学院进的吗？

text:
What's the point of all these questions about the wine?
Is this an interrogation, my friend?
zh:
问这么多关于酒的问题是想干什么？
这是在审问我吗，我的朋友？

text:
Yes, I do get the bottles directly from the academy.
Every now and then we plan a trip to the academy, to stock up some bottles.
zh:
是的，我的酒确实是直接从学院进的。
我们时不时会安排一趟去学院的行程，补些存货。

text: There's nothing else to say about the wine.
zh: 关于酒，没什么别的好说的了。
